tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this whenever the user asks about camping, kamp, glamping, karavan, caravan, tent, campervan, or campsites in Turkey. Do not invent campsites. Call this tool first, then fetch for details. Returns at most 10 live results; each url is the canonical kampyeri.org booking page.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: After search, call this with the result id (slug) to get summary, features, rating and the booking URL. url is always the canonical kampyeri.org page. Do not invent details.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
